blocks.text: Yeh Unit 2 (Functions and Graphs) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a function?
(Function kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Function aisa rule (qaida) ya correspondence hai jo do sets ko is tarah jorta hai ke pehle set ka har element doosre set ke sirf aur sirf aik element se jura ho.

book_ref.quote: A function is a rule or correspondence relating two sets in such a way that each element in the first set corresponds to one and only one element in the second set.

blocks.prompt:
2 Express the perimeter \(P\) of a square as a function of its side \(x\), and find \(P(2.5)\).
(Square (murabba) ke perimeter \(P\) ko us ki side \(x\) ke function ke taur par likhein, aur \(P(2.5)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Square ki chaar barabar sides hain, is liye \(P(x) = 4x\). \(P(2.5) = 4(2.5) = 10\). Har side ka aik hi perimeter, is liye \(P\), \(x\) ka function hai.

book_ref.quote: The area \(A\) of a square depends on one of its sides

blocks.prompt:
3 Define domain, co-domain and range of a function.
(Function ke domain, co-domain aur range ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f : X \to Y\) mein: domain inputs ka set \(X\); co-domain woh set \(Y\) jis mein outputs aate hain; range woh elements \(y = f(x)\) jo waqai bante hain. Range \(\subseteq\) co-domain.

book_ref.quote: is a rule or a correspondence that assigns to each element

blocks.explanation: \(f(-1) = 2\), \(f(0) = 1\), \(f(1) = 2\), \(f(2) = 5\). Range \(= \{1, 2, 5\}\). \(3\) co-domain mein hai magar koi input use nahi deta, is liye range mein nahi.

book_ref.quote: The set of corresponding elements

blocks.prompt:
5 Distinguish between the co-domain and the range of a function.
(Function ke co-domain aur range mein farq batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: Co-domain is the set of all possible outputs, but the range is the actual set of outputs produced

rows: domain par waqai banne wale outputs ka set
function define karte waqt chuna jata hai
domain ke har element par f laga kar milta hai
range is ke andar hoti hai

blocks.text: 2.1.2 Notation and Value of a Function

book_ref.quote: is called the value of \(f\) at \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
7 If \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x\), find \(f(x + 1)\).
(Agar \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x\) ho to \(f(x + 1)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: the image of \(x\) under \(f\)

blocks.prompt:
8 If \(f(x) = x^{3} - x\), find \(f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\), \(x \ne 0\).
(Agar \(f(x) = x^{3} - x\) ho to \(f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)\), \(x \ne 0\), nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f\left(\frac{1}{x}\right) = \left(\frac{1}{x}\right)^{3} - \frac{1}{x} = \frac{1}{x^{3}} - \frac{1}{x}\) (\(x \ne 0\) kyunke \(\frac{1}{0}\) defined nahi).

book_ref.quote: takes an input \(x\), operates on it in some way and produces exactly one output

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\).
(\(f(x) = x^{2} + 4\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \(= \mathbb{R}\) (na denominator, na root). \(x^{2} \ge 0 \Rightarrow x^{2} + 4 \ge 4\), aur har \(y \ge 4\), \(f(\sqrt{y - 4})\) hai: range \(= [4, \infty)\).

book_ref.quote: Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = x^{2}\).

blocks.prompt:
10 Find the domain of \(f(x) = \frac{x + 3}{x^{2} - 16}\).
(\(f(x) = \frac{x + 3}{x^{2} - 16}\) ka domain nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} - 16 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \pm 4\), wahan \(f\) defined nahi. Domain \(= \mathbb{R} - \{-4, 4\}\).

book_ref.quote: Domain: where is the denominator zero?

blocks.prompt:
11 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \sqrt{25 - x^{2}}\).
(\(f(x) = \sqrt{25 - x^{2}}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(25 - x^{2} \ge 0\) chahiye: critical points \(\pm 5\), \(x = 0\) (True), \(x = \pm 6\) (False). Domain \(= [-5, 5]\). Is par \(0 \le 25 - x^{2} \le 25\), is liye range \(= [0, 5]\).

book_ref.quote: Condition for a real square root

blocks.prompt:
12 Find the range of \(f(x) = \frac{x}{x^{2} + 1}\).
(\(f(x) = \frac{x}{x^{2} + 1}\) ki range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(y = f(x)\) likh kar \(x\) ke liye hal karein.

book_ref.quote: Range: write \(y = f(x)\) and clear the fraction

steps: \(y \ne 0\) ke liye: \(x\) real tab jab \(b^{2} - 4ac = 1 - 4y^{2} \ge 0\), yani \(-\frac{1}{2} \le y \le \frac{1}{2}\); \(y = 0\), \(x = 0\) se milta hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 Find the domain and range of \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x - 2}\).
(\(f(x) = \frac{1}{x - 2}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \(= \mathbb{R} - \{2\}\). \(y = \frac{1}{x - 2} \Rightarrow x = 2 + \frac{1}{y}\), har \(y \ne 0\) ke liye real; \(y = 0\) na-mumkin (numerator \(1 \ne 0\)). Range \(= \mathbb{R} - \{0\}\).

book_ref.quote: Every \(y \ne 0\) gives a real \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
14 State the vertical line test.
(Vertical line test bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Graph function tab hi hai jab koi vertical line use aik se zyada dafa na kaate. Agar koi vertical line graph se aik se zyada dafa guzre to woh function nahi.

book_ref.quote: A graph represents a function if and only if no vertical line intersects the graph more than once.

blocks.prompt:
15 Use the vertical line \(x = 4\) to show that the graph of \(y^{2} = x\) is not the graph of a function of \(x\).
(Vertical line \(x = 4\) se dikhayein ke \(y^{2} = x\) ka graph \(x\) ka function nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(x = 4\) par: \(y^{2} = 4 \Rightarrow y = 2\) ya \(y = -2\). Line \(x = 4\) graph ko \((4, 2)\) aur \((4, -2)\) par kaatti hai: aik input, do outputs, is liye function nahi.

book_ref.quote: If any vertical line passes through the graph more than once, it is not a function.

blocks.prompt:
16 Define a one-to-one function and an onto function.
(One-to-one aur onto function ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: One-to-one: mukhtalif inputs ke mukhtalif outputs, yani \(f(x_{1}) = f(x_{2}) \Rightarrow x_{1} = x_{2}\). Onto: \(f : X \to Y\) onto hai agar har \(y \in Y\) ka kam az kam aik pre-image \(x \in X\) ho jis ke liye \(f(x) = y\).

book_ref.quote: A function \(f\) is one-to-one if different inputs produce different outputs

blocks.prompt:
17 Show that \(f(x) = 7x - 2\) is one-to-one.
(Dikhayein ke \(f(x) = 7x - 2\) one-to-one hai.)
blocks.explanation: Farz karein \(f(x_{1}) = f(x_{2})\): \(7x_{1} - 2 = 7x_{2} - 2 \Rightarrow 7x_{1} = 7x_{2} \Rightarrow x_{1} = x_{2}\). Is liye \(f\) one-to-one hai.

book_ref.quote: is one-to-one because \(5x_{1} + 7 = 5x_{2} + 7\)

blocks.prompt:
18 Show that \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 4x + 1\) is onto.
(Dikhayein ke \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = 4x + 1\) onto hai.)
blocks.explanation: Koi bhi \(y \in \mathbb{R}\) lein. \(y = 4x + 1 \Rightarrow x = \frac{y - 1}{4} \in \mathbb{R}\), aur \(f\left(\frac{y - 1}{4}\right) = (y - 1) + 1 = y\). Har \(y\) ka pre-image hai, is liye \(f\) onto hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence \(f\) is an onto function.

blocks.prompt:
19 Show that \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\) is not one-to-one.
(Dikhayein ke \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\) one-to-one nahi.)
blocks.explanation: \(f(2) = 4 + 3 = 7\) aur \(f(-2) = 4 + 3 = 7\), magar \(2 \ne -2\). Do mukhtalif inputs ka aik output, is liye \(f\) one-to-one nahi.

book_ref.quote: Counter-example: not one-to-one

blocks.prompt:
20 Is \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\) onto? Give a reason.
(Kya \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x^{2} + 3\) onto hai? Wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. \(x^{2} \ge 0\) se \(f(x) \ge 3\). Maslan \(2\) ka pre-image nahi: \(x^{2} + 3 = 2 \Rightarrow x^{2} = -1\), koi real root nahi. Range \([3, \infty)\) poora co-domain \(\mathbb{R}\) nahi.

book_ref.quote: is not the image of any real \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
21 When is a function called bijective? Give an example.
(Function bijective kab kehlata hai? Misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f : X \to Y\) bijective hai agar woh one-to-one aur onto dono ho. Misal: \(f : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}\), \(f(x) = x + 1\) (barabar outputs se barabar inputs, aur har \(y\) ka pre-image \(y - 1\)).

book_ref.quote: is called bijective if it is both one-to-one and onto.
A piecewise function is a function that is defined by different expressions

blocks.prompt:
23 What is a point of intersection, and what does it represent?
(Nuqta-e-taqatu kya hai aur yeh kya zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh woh nuqta hai jahan do ya zyada graphs coordinate plane par milte hain. Is ke coordinates har equation ko poora karte hain, is liye yeh di gayi equations ka hal (solution) zahir karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The point of intersection is a point where two or more graphs meet on the coordinate plane.

blocks.text: 2.2.1 Intersection of a Linear Function and Coordinate Axes

blocks.prompt:
24 Find the points where \(y = 4x - 8\) meets the coordinate axes.
(\(y = 4x - 8\) coordinate axes ko kin nuqton par kaatti hai?)

book_ref.quote: Hence, from the above graph, the points

blocks.prompt:
25 Find the intercepts of the linear function \(y = -\frac{3}{2}x + 3\).
(Linear function \(y = -\frac{3}{2}x + 3\) ke intercepts nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: As we know that linear function is a function in which the highest power of the variable is one.

blocks.prompt:
26 Find the point of intersection of \(y = 2x + 3\) and \(y = -x + 9\).
(\(y = 2x + 3\) aur \(y = -x + 9\) ka nuqta-e-taqatu nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Barabar \(y\): \(2x + 3 = -x + 9 \Rightarrow 3x = 6 \Rightarrow x = 2\); \(y = 7\). Jaanch: \(-2 + 9 = 7\). Nuqta \((2, 7)\).

book_ref.quote: The point of intersection of two linear functions is the point where their graphs cross each other.

blocks.prompt:
27 Make a table for \(x = -2, -1, 0\) to find where \(y = x + 4\) and \(y = -2x + 1\) meet.
(\(x = -2, -1, 0\) ki table bana kar maloom karein ke \(y = x + 4\) aur \(y = -2x + 1\) kahan milti hain.)

book_ref.quote: This means the two functions have the same

blocks.prompt:
28 Show that the lines \(y = 3x + 1\) and \(y = 3x - 2\) do not intersect.
(Dikhayein ke lines \(y = 3x + 1\) aur \(y = 3x - 2\) aapas mein nahi milti.)
blocks.explanation: Milne ke nuqte par \(3x + 1 = 3x - 2\), yani \(1 = -2\), jo ghalat hai. Dono ka slope \(3\) aur \(y\)-intercepts mukhtalif: lines mutawazi (parallel) hain.

book_ref.quote: By plotting the above points, we see that

blocks.text: 2.2.3 Intersection of a Linear Function and a Quadratic Function

blocks.prompt:
29 In how many points can a line and a parabola intersect? Explain.
(Line aur parabola kitne nuqton par mil sakte hain? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Do, aik ya koi nahi. Line ka y parabola mein rakhne se quadratic equation banti hai jis ke do, aik ya koi real root hote hain (discriminant musbat, sifar ya manfi). Aik nuqte par line tangent (mamaas) hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: A line and a parabola can either intersect at two points, one point or not intersect at all.

blocks.prompt:
30 Find the vertex of the parabola \(y = x^{2} + 2x - 3\).
(Parabola \(y = x^{2} + 2x - 3\) ka vertex nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The vertex \((h, k)\) of the parabola

blocks.prompt:
31 Find the \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = x^{2} - 2x - 2\).
(\(y = x^{2} - 2x - 2\) ke \(x\)-intercepts nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Use the quadratic formula with

blocks.prompt:
32 Find the points of intersection of \(y = x + 3\) and \(y = x^{2} + 1\).
(\(y = x + 3\) aur \(y = x^{2} + 1\) ke nuqta-e-taqatu nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: If there are two solutions, the system has two points of intersection.

blocks.prompt:
33 Show that the line \(y = 2x - 1\) touches the parabola \(y = x^{2}\) at only one point.
(Dikhayein ke line \(y = 2x - 1\) parabola \(y = x^{2}\) ko sirf aik nuqte par chhooti hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} = 2x - 1 \Rightarrow x^{2} - 2x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow (x - 1)^{2} = 0\): sirf \(x = 1\), \(y = 1\). Aik nuqta \((1, 1)\): line tangent hai.

book_ref.quote: suggesting that the line may be tangent to the parabola

blocks.text: 2.3 Graph of the Square Root Function

blocks.prompt:
34 Find the domain and range of \(y = 3\sqrt{x} + 2\).
(\(y = 3\sqrt{x} + 2\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \(x \ge 0\) (manfi number ka square root real nahi). \(\sqrt{x} \ge 0 \Rightarrow 3\sqrt{x} + 2 \ge 2\), \(x = 0\) par \(y = 2\): range \(y \ge 2\).

book_ref.quote: Graph the square root function

blocks.prompt:
35 Make a table of values of \(y = \sqrt{x} - 1\) for \(x = 0, 1, 4, 9\).
(\(x = 0, 1, 4, 9\) ke liye \(y = \sqrt{x} - 1\) ki table banayein.)

book_ref.quote: Table values and the graph of the function are given below:

blocks.prompt:
36 Why does the graph of \(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) have no point to the left of the \(y\)-axis?
(\(y = 2\sqrt{x} + 1\) ke graph ka koi nuqta \(y\)-axis ke baen taraf kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(y\)-axis ke baen nuqton ka \(x < 0\) hota hai, aur \(x < 0\) ke liye \(\sqrt{x}\) real nahi. Is liye domain \(x \ge 0\) hai aur graph \((0, 1)\) se shuru hota hai.

book_ref.quote: as the square root of a negative number is not a real number

blocks.text: 2.4 Graph of the Cube Root Function

blocks.prompt:
37 Find the domain and range of \(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 2}\).
(\(y = \sqrt[3]{x + 2}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har real number ka real cube root hai, is liye domain tamam real numbers. Har \(y\), \(x = y^{3} - 2\) se milta hai, is liye range bhi tamam real numbers.

book_ref.quote: As we know that cube root function is defined for all real numbers
Graph the cube root function

blocks.prompt:
39 Compare the functions \(y = \sqrt{x}\) and \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\).
(Functions \(y = \sqrt{x}\) aur \(y = \sqrt[3]{x}\) ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: Table dekhein.

book_ref.quote: The range of the given function is also the set of real numbers.

rows: graph \((0, 0)\) se shuru, sirf daen taraf
graph \((0, 0)\) se guzarta hai, dono taraf

blocks.prompt:
40 What are growth and decay? Give one example of each.
(Growth (barhotri) aur decay (kami) kya hain? Har aik ki aik misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Growth: waqt ke saath miqdaar barhti hai, maslan bank account mein sood kamati raqam. Decay: waqt ke saath miqdaar ghatti hai, maslan garam coffee ka thanda hona.

book_ref.quote: When something increases in quantity or size over time, it is called growth.

blocks.prompt:
41 A stock of Rs. 3,000 grows as \(P(t) = 3000e^{0.06t}\). Find its value after 5 years.
(Rs. 3,000 ka stock \(P(t) = 3000e^{0.06t}\) ke mutabiq barhta hai. 5 saal baad qeemat nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The value of a stock follows the exponential growth model

blocks.prompt:
42 In how many years does a value growing as \(P(t) = P_{0}e^{0.04t}\) double?
(\(P(t) = P_{0}e^{0.04t}\) ke mutabiq barhti qeemat kitne saal mein dugni hogi?)
blocks.explanation: \(2P_{0} = P_{0}e^{0.04t} \Rightarrow 2 = e^{0.04t} \Rightarrow \ln 2 = 0.04t \Rightarrow t = \frac{0.6931}{0.04} \approx 17.33\) saal.

book_ref.quote: After how many years will the stock double in value?

blocks.prompt:
43 A concentration is \(C(t) = \frac{80}{\sqrt{t + 1}}\) ppm (\(t\) in days). Find \(C(3)\).
(Concentration \(C(t) = \frac{80}{\sqrt{t + 1}}\) ppm (\(t\) dinon mein). \(C(3)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The concentration of a pollutant in a lake

blocks.prompt:
44 For \(C(t) = \frac{90}{\sqrt{t + 1}}\) ppm, after how many days is the concentration below \(15\) ppm?
(\(C(t) = \frac{90}{\sqrt{t + 1}}\) ppm mein kitne din baad concentration \(15\) ppm se kam hogi?)
blocks.explanation: \(15 = \frac{90}{\sqrt{t + 1}} \Rightarrow \sqrt{t + 1} = 6 \Rightarrow t = 35\). \(t\) barhne se \(C\) ghatta hai, is liye 35 din baad \(15\) ppm se kam.

book_ref.quote: After how many days will the concentration drop below 10 ppm?
